beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It should also record relevant boundaries, scale, and the period being compared.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The cloud example rewards attention because familiar language hides a consequential choice.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The fuller chapter offers several continuity dimensions rather than one universal definition of identity.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The proposed controlled layer is called SOP Lang English, or SLEnglish.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its statements use a regular outer form with named parameters.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Each statement receives an explicit identity that later statements can reference.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A path selects an operator whose contract defines its meaning.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This arrangement concentrates semantic variation in libraries instead of an expanding parser grammar.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book explains the syntax alongside its costs and provisional design choices.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: You can read it as an inspectable proposal rather than a finished universal language.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A directory of impressive operator names would not make an executable language.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Each operator needs declared parameters, accepted types, outputs, and compatible interpretation profiles.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its contract also records relevant context, effects, tests, and version history.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This is where a readable label acquires a specific computational obligation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The appendices connect these contracts to evidence, identity, agency, and systems concepts.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: They let readers inspect concrete proposals after following the broader argument.
